pr_title: HTTP2: Fix hashCode() and equals(...) implementation
pr_body:
Motivation:

Our implementations of hashCode() and equals(...) were not correct for some frames.

Modifications:

Correctly implement both methods

Result:

Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/13659
pr_comments: Let's just keep it as it is

issue_context.title: `AbstractHttp2StreamFrame` and `DefaultHttp2PingFrame` `hashCode` seems incorrect

review_comments: Are two `DefaultHttp2FrameStream` considered equal if `this.stream == that.stream == null`?
I would say yes, but it's a good point @bryce-anderson (maybe I'm wrong!)

I think they'd be considered equal as well, although I don't believe it's covered by this implementation.
This would probably do it:
```
return this.id == that.id && Objects.equals(this.stream, that.stream);
```
